prompt: Use case: style-transfer. This is a QUIET FFXIV UTILITY/MENU icon study. Image 1 is the original plugin identity. Image 2 contains actual FFXIV utility/menu icons (Character, Inventory, Journal, Map, Settings): emulate THESE, NOT combat abilities. Produce ONE square replacement of image 1, keeping its main symbol and characteristic colors recognizable. Follow the utility references' simple lightly raised/embossed symbol, restrained soft painted shading, crisp silhouette and shallow shadow. The foreground must be easy to parse immediately at 40x40 pixels. BACKGROUND: plain smooth matte dark charcoal (#25282d), absolutely quiet, uniform except the faint shallow shadow immediately beneath the symbol. No visible background brush texture, no vignette rings, no patterns, no streaks. Foreground: modest bevel, broad calm surfaces, restrained muted highlights; no glaring specular shine. Do NOT add flames, aura, glowing outlines, magic trails, swirls, stars, particles, sparkles, lens flares, dramatic rays or extra decorative objects. Avoid glossy crystal, photorealistic 3D and the previous glowing combat-icon aesthetic. Full-bleed square canvas, central symbol around 75 percent of canvas with consistent breathing room. No text, numerals, watermark, UI, original outer app frame, corner badge or extra border. Keep the icon's original color identity but reduce saturation and brightness slightly for a native utility feel. Preserve exactly the eight-toothed cog with its curved four-point-star opening and four narrow diagonal apertures. Left side restrained teal/cyan, right side restrained violet/magenta, a subtle smooth transition. Treat it like a lightly raised enamel utility glyph, not an explosive magical cog. The star opening and small apertures must stay clean and dark. No gold trim.
